nom: Urang Prestige Purple Shield Essence Toner

avis.titre: Expensive but worth itExpensive but worth it
avis.texte: This might be the strangest skin care product my wife has ever ordered, but she LOVES it. The package has a QR code that brings you to a YouTube site where you can listen to the music the craftspeople who made this product listened to while they made it. It’s nice, mellow guitar music. She has never encountered a skin care product with this detail before. The product itself comes in a gorgeous glass bottle. It has a little plastic seal under the lid that you can reuse to keep the product fresh. The product itself is slightly watery and also moisturizing. It has a light, pleasant scent. The product is purple, and if purple had a smell, this would be it. It’s not drying like alcohol based toners can be. She used this after cleansing. It takes very little to cover her face, neck, décolletage, and hands, so this 3.88 oz bottle will last a long time. After applying this toner, she put on a few drops of argan oil, and went to bed. The next day, her skin is so soft. She loves this! It is expensive, however, 65 dollars for 3.88 oz works out to $16.75 per ounce, which actually isn’t bad. Also, this bottle will last a long time. She has researched all the ingredients through Environmental Working Group’s website, and they are all safe.

avis.titre: Have never been “wowed” by a toner, until this one!
avis.texte: I have used tons of toners, to the point I actually do without them a lot of times in my skincare routine. But this URANG Prestige Purple Shield Essence Toner seemed different, and it absolutely is different, in a good way!! It is super lightweight. A little goes a long way. Not drying or stripping at all - quite the opposite where my skin actually feels soothed, nourished and hydrated after using. I have combination and fairly sensitive skin and have had zero adverse reactions. I also love that you can use this as a “mask”! Use as a quick mask. Soak a cotton pad with the essence toner and place it on the skin for 5-10 minutes. I’m not a huge “mask” gal, but letting this soak into my skin for 5-10 minutes makes my skin feel amazing!! I love it! It will last me a while as it’s a large bottle and a little goes a long way! Definitely recommend, it’s worth trying out!!

I've been using this face toner daily for a couple of weeks now and I don't think it has done anything to eliminate my wrinkles but I have noticed that my skin looks better. It looks a little more plump with a rosy tint to it, healthier. I haven't received any compliments so it's not an obvious improvement but I'm seeing something I like. Maybe it's in my head, I don't know. The liquid is not alcohol, it feels like water with a slight slippery feel that allows you to spread it around your face. A little goes a long way. Once the liquid dries, the slippery/tackiness goes away and you're left feeling like you have nothing on your face. I don't notice much of a smell so I don't think it will be an issue for people who have a sensitive nose. I have been taking pictures which I'll post IF I see any obvious improvement on my skin. For now, I will continue to enjoy using the product and enjoy the slight improvement I'm seeing, even if my eyes are deceiving me!

avis.titre: Love this toner! Skin feels moisture after use!
avis.texte: I really love toners, and this toner especially is great! I love putting it on everyday after cleaning my face first, it feels really nice and light and feels like it’s moisturizing my face. After it doesn’t feel sticky and you don’t need a lot of this product to cover your whole face. It’s nice the way it comes In an elegant glass bottle with it capped and has a small whole so you don’t spill a bunch out at one time. There was extra protective plastic in place so when packaged so it won’t leak out until you open it and even then it has a little hole so it doesn’t just gush all over. I really am glad I got this toner and intend to keep using it! I love the ingredients as well as they are all natural which it says on the box it comes in with the list of what’s in the toner. My skin looks more glowing after I use this and I noticed especially in the morning after I apply it at night, my skin wakes up to looking great, I’m impressed in a great way! I’d definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a good toner to make their skin shine. That’s how it works for me and I’m happy. I also love that it’s anti aging and cruelty free.

avis.titre: URANG Prestige Purple Shield Essence Toner
avis.texte: This URANG prestige purple shield essence toner is really nice! I love it and I can't believe that I love it because I have so many toners, and I didn't think that I needed anymore, but this toner is one of my most favorites! It's lightweight, and it doesn't feel sticky. It absorbs well into my skin, and it doesn't cause any irritation. It also has anti aging benefits. My skin looks better since I've been using it.

I wish I could love this serum more, but I have dry sensitive skin and this actually stings my face a little bit. I start using it on my neck which works fine. Very hydrating and refreshing. Wish it could work on my face as well.

avis.titre: Too hydrating for my oily skin
avis.texte: Ugh - I wish I didn't battle oily skin or this would have been 5 stars. This toner is ultra hydrating, comes in a pretty bottle and is made with quality ingredients. Unfortunately, it was just too much for my oily skin and left me with more shine that usual. Other than that, I experience no adverse effects. If you have dry skin, this could be a great product for you.
This toner smells nice and feels clean on the skin. Comes in a glass bottle - maybe plastic would be better.

Interesting product. I do like it but I'm taking off a star for the price. With that price tag I also feel like the bottle should be bigger.. The ingredients are great and the application is really nice, my face feels really good after putting this on. I feel it evens it out and makes it overall look better and healthier. It is very moisturizing but not to the point where it feels like there's product sitting on your skin. I think this would work for most skintypes and I am looking forward to seeing the anti aging benefits. All in all a pricy, but very nice product.

avis.titre: Skin looks better after short use!
avis.texte: So far, this toner is amazing! After a few weeks of use, my skin looks and feels better. I have sensitive skin, and this doesn't irritate me, but actually calms it down. My pores look smaller and my skin feels better. I have been using it twice, in the morning I use as directed, patting it into my skin. At night, I am applying it to a cotton swab and wiping over my face. It isn’t sticky, and leaves my skin feeling hydrated-not drying at all. I love all the ingredients, mainly botanicals. The packaging is super cute and even has a QR code with a music playlist. I highly recommend this product and will definitely be purchasing again!

URANG Prestige Purple Shield Essence Toner, (3.88 fl oz) hydrates my skin and feels refreshing. This toner shrinks my pores and moisturizes. All organic ingredients such as ballon flower extract. I like how this toner isn’t sticky and quickly absorbs into my skin. Alcohol free. Strongly recommend for daily use!

This is definitely one of the most top-tier facial essences that I have ever used! It did not feel sticky when applying it to my face and did not leave any weird residue once it dried! I like to use this essence during my morning skincare routine because it is so lightweight. Highly recommend it 100%! Be sure to use on clean skin and wash your hands before you apply it to your face.
